note: Curated list; verified=true means the URL was fetched and confirmed on the update date. Suggest additions via a GitHub issue.

resources.name: Pacific Parkinson's Research Centre - Jon Stoessl
resources.institution: University of British Columbia / Djavad Mowafaghian Centre for Brain Health, Vancouver
resources.description: PET research on Parkinson's disease including landmark work on dopamine release underlying placebo responses in PD.

resources.name: Centre for Evidence-Based Medicine Odense (CEBMO) / Cochrane Denmark
resources.institution: University of Southern Denmark / Odense University Hospital
resources.description: Methodological placebo research: Cochrane review 'Placebo interventions for all clinical conditions', active placebo controls, trial methodology and bias.

resources.name: CRC/TRR 289 Treatment Expectation (Collaborative Research Centre)
resources.institution: University Duisburg-Essen, Philipps-University Marburg, University Medical Center Hamburg-Eppendorf
resources.description: DFG-funded transregional research centre (16 projects, ~19 PIs across Essen, Marburg, Hamburg) studying psychological and neurobiological mechanisms of treatment expectation, placebo and nocebo effects in pain, depression and beyond. Research network page: https://treatment-expectation.de/en/vision-objectives/research-network

resources.name: Center of Medical Psychology and Translational Neuroscience (MedPsychNeuro)
resources.institution: Ruhr University Bochum, Faculty of Medicine
resources.description: Placebo and nocebo effects in visceral pain and brain-gut interactions (e.g., NoVis nocebo study), pain-related learning and expectation. Director profile: https://medpsychneuro.ruhr-uni-bochum.de/en/about-us/elsenbruch

resources.name: Institute of Medical Psychology and Behavioral Immunobiology
resources.institution: University Hospital Essen, University of Duisburg-Essen
resources.description: Institute focused on neurobiology and clinical applicability of placebo and nocebo responses, particularly Pavlovian conditioning of immune and neuroendocrine functions; partner in TRR 289 Treatment Expectation and SFB 1280 Extinction Learning.

resources.name: Center for Interdisciplinary Placebo Studies Leiden (IPS Leiden)
resources.institution: Leiden University, Institute of Psychology (Health, Medical and Neuropsychology)
resources.lead: Andrea Evers (founder, deceased); Henriët van Middendorp, Judy Veldhuijzen, Kaya Peerdeman, Antoinette van Laarhoven, Sylvia van Beugen, Aleksandrina Skvortsova, Liesbeth van Vliet
resources.description: Interdisciplinary centre on placebo/nocebo effects in pain, itch, fatigue and immune outcomes, pharmacological conditioning, communication and training tools for clinicians (Peerdeman's communication/expectation work, ECCO-related projects).

resources.name: Acupuncture and Meridian Science Research Center (AMSRC)
resources.institution: Kyung Hee University, Seoul
resources.lead: Prof. Hye Jung Lee (director); Younbyoung Chae
resources.description: National research center (est. 2005) on mechanisms of acupuncture including placebo/sham-needle credibility and expectation-related analgesia; verified via KHU national research centers page (amsrc.org itself uses a JS cookie challenge).

resources.name: Placebo Beyond Opinions (PBO) Center
resources.institution: University of Maryland School of Nursing, Baltimore
resources.description: Organized research center advancing interdisciplinary research and education on placebo, nocebo and expectation effects, with emphasis on health equity, clinical-trial design and digital therapeutics.

resources.name: UF Pain Research and Intervention Center of Excellence (PRICE)
resources.institution: University of Florida
resources.description: Interdisciplinary pain center studying individual differences in pain, including experimental placebo analgesia and placebo mechanisms in older adults.

resources.name: Stoneygate Centre for Empathic Healthcare
resources.institution: University of Leicester
resources.description: UK centre on empathy and placebo/context effects in healthcare (author of 'The Power of Placebos'). Official centre URL https://le.ac.uk/stoneygate-centre-empathic-healthcare returned 403 to automated fetchers; director's site verified instead.

resources.name: JIPS - Journal of Interdisciplinary Placebo Studies (placebo literature update service)
resources.institution: University Hospital Tübingen / Ulm University (SIPS)
resources.description: Free monthly PubMed-based compilation of new placebo/nocebo papers, maintained since 2016; database of >4,000 papers. Key seed source and prominent link target for the Science of Placebo hub.

resources.name: Tübingen Placebo Research database (placeboforschung.uni-tuebingen.de)
resources.institution: University of Tübingen (Enck/Weimer)
resources.description: Registration-walled ~5,400-paper placebo literature library associated with JIPS. Hostname did not resolve during verification (DNS failure); may be retired or moved.

resources.name: Tübingen Placebo Literature Database (JIPS database login)
resources.institution: University Hospital Tübingen (Enck/Weimer)
resources.description: Registration-based searchable database (title, authors, abstract, MeSH) of ~5,000+ placebo/nocebo papers underlying JIPS. Host did not resolve (DNS) when fetched on 2026-09-02; may be offline or renamed.

resources.name: Damien Finniss – Pain Management Research Institute
resources.institution: University of Sydney / Royal North Shore Hospital, Pain Management Research Institute
resources.description: Clinician-researcher and Australian pioneer of clinical placebo research (Lancet 2010 review with Benedetti, Kaptchuk); Treasurer (formerly Chair) of the IASP Pain and Placebo SIG. Official profile (JS-rendered; HTTP 200).

resources.name: Kate Faasse – Health Psychology / Nocebo research (UNSW)
resources.institution: UNSW Sydney, School of Psychology
resources.description: Research on nocebo effects, open-label placebos, generic-medicine switching, social learning and health misinformation; ARC DECRA awardee, formerly of Petrie's Auckland group.

resources.name: Kevin Keay Lab (animal models of placebo/nocebo)
resources.institution: University of Sydney, School of Medical Sciences, Brain and Mind Centre
resources.description: Conditioned placebo analgesia and nocebo hyperalgesia in rats with neuropathic pain (c-Fos mapping, enriched environments) and direct cross-species comparisons with human fMRI. Official profile (JS-rendered; HTTP 200).

resources.name: Kirsten Barnes – nocebo/placebo social learning research (UNSW)
resources.institution: UNSW Sydney, School of Psychology
resources.description: Experimental work on socially transmitted nocebo effects, practitioner warmth/empathy, side-effect information and open-label placebo expectations (with Faasse and Colagiuri). Official profile returned HTTP 403 to automated fetch, so not confirmed.

resources.name: Louise Sharpe Lab (Clinical Psychology, placebo/nocebo group)
resources.institution: University of Sydney, School of Psychology
resources.description: ~10-person group focused on placebo and nocebo effects in chronic pain and illness, including attention/VR paradigms for nocebo hyperalgesia and clinical/community applications with Colagiuri. Official profile page (JS-rendered; returns HTTP 200).

resources.name: Luke Henderson Neural Imaging Laboratory
resources.institution: University of Sydney, School of Medical Sciences (Neuroscience), Brain and Mind Centre
resources.description: Ultra-high-field (7T) fMRI of brainstem and forebrain circuits underlying placebo analgesia and nocebo hyperalgesia; placebo responder/non-responder network studies. Official profile (JS-rendered; HTTP 200).

resources.name: Sydney Placebo Lab
resources.institution: University of Sydney, School of Psychology / Brain and Mind Centre
resources.description: Experimental and observational research on placebo and nocebo mechanisms across pain, sleep, nausea and medication side effects (TENS, VR, EEG, CHEPS). Colagiuri is current SIPS President and Co-Director of the Brain and Mind Centre; the lab hosts SIPS 2027.

resources.name: Clinical Psychology (Schienle group) - open-label placebo research
resources.institution: University of Graz
resources.description: Prolific open-label placebo program (emotional distress, skin-picking, relaxation training, food-cue reactivity/obesity in children; FWF-funded). News: https://www.uni-graz.at/en/news/wie-der-placeboeffekt-kindern-beim-abnehmen-hilft/

resources.name: Applied Physiology & Nutrition Research Group (open-placebo in exercise)
resources.institution: University of São Paulo, School of Physical Education and Sport / FMUSP Rheumatology
resources.description: Sport-science group publishing open-placebo and expectancy studies of exercise performance (e.g., female cyclists). No dedicated lab page found; URL is a representative open-access paper.

resources.name: MOGILab (Pain Genetics Lab)
resources.institution: McGill University, Alan Edwards Centre for Research on Pain, Montreal
resources.description: Mouse pain lab with experimental work on placebo analgesia and nocebo-like behaviour in rodents, sex differences and social modulation of pain.

resources.name: Michael Lifshitz - Psychedelics and Contemplation Lab
resources.institution: McGill University / Jewish General Hospital, Division of Social and Transcultural Psychiatry
resources.description: Studies practices that transform subjective experience, including placebos, hypnosis, meditation and psychedelics, combining neuroscience and ethnography.

resources.name: Placebo/nocebo fMRI group, Zhujiang Hospital, Southern Medical University
resources.institution: Southern Medical University (Zhujiang Hospital, Dept. of Rehabilitation), Guangzhou
resources.description: Publishes fMRI studies of personality differences and brain networks in placebo analgesia and nocebo hyperalgesia in experimental low back pain. No official lab page found; URL is a representative open-access paper.

resources.name: Tu Lab – Institute of Psychology, Chinese Academy of Sciences
resources.institution: Institute of Psychology, Chinese Academy of Sciences (State Key Lab of Cognitive Science and Mental Health), Beijing
resources.description: Pain neuroimaging and neuromodulation lab; PNAS 2021 work with Kong/Kaptchuk/Benedetti manipulating placebo analgesia and nocebo hyperalgesia via tDCS. Page fetched via curl (self-signed cert); the listed lab site tulab.psych.ac.cn did not resolve.

resources.name: Lene Vase - Placebo research, Department of Psychology and Behavioural Sciences
resources.institution: Aarhus University
resources.description: Placebo analgesia and nocebo hyperalgesia mechanisms, placebo responses in RCTs and meta-analyses, control interventions, placebo in Alzheimer's and migraine.

resources.name: SOCIALHEALTH team (Leonie Koban)
resources.institution: Lyon Neuroscience Research Centre (CRNL), CNRS
resources.description: Social, affective and health neuroscience: social influences and expectations on pain, placebo effects on social and physical pain (fMRI, psychophysiology). CRNL page (403 to bots): https://www.crnl.fr/en/user/961

resources.name: ThEMAS team, TIMC laboratory (open-label placebo / PlacEthic)
resources.institution: Université Grenoble Alpes / CNRS (TIMC UMR 5525)
resources.description: Open-label vs deceptive placebo studies (PlacEthic, NCT03934138), placebo acceptability in France, placebo in physiotherapy and critical thinking in healthcare.

resources.name: BüchelLab - Institute of Systems Neuroscience
resources.institution: University Medical Center Hamburg-Eppendorf (UKE)
resources.description: Neuroimaging lab on pain, placebo and nocebo analgesia, including combined brain-spinal cord fMRI, opioidergic mechanisms and price-dependent nocebo effects (Alexandra Tinnermann).

resources.name: Clinical Psychology and Psychotherapy (Nestoriuc group)
resources.institution: Helmut-Schmidt-University Hamburg / UKE
resources.description: Group studying placebo and nocebo effects, side-effect expectations and expectation management (nocebo information, antidepressant discontinuation, open-label placebo N-of-1 trials); TRR 289 member.

resources.name: Clinical Psychology and Psychotherapy (Rief group)
resources.institution: Philipps-University Marburg
resources.description: Research unit on expectation, placebo and nocebo mechanisms in medical and psychological treatments (ViolEx model, expectation optimization before surgery, antidepressant placebo effects); Marburg site of TRR 289.

resources.name: Max Planck Research Group Pain Perception
resources.institution: Max Planck Institute for Human Cognitive and Brain Sciences, Leipzig
resources.description: Computational and spinal-cord neuroimaging group studying cognitive modulation of pain including placebo analgesia and expectation-driven pain modulation.

resources.name: Pain Medicine and Pain Psychology - placebo research (Regine Klinger)
resources.institution: University Medical Center Hamburg-Eppendorf (UKE), Department of Anaesthesiology
resources.description: Study group on clinical implications of placebo research: expectation, conditioning, open-label placebo and observational learning in chronic/postoperative pain and itch; TRR 289 site Hamburg. UKE working-group page: https://www.uke.de/kliniken-institute/kliniken/an%C3%A4sthesiologie/forschung/arbeitsgruppen/agschmerzforschung.html

resources.name: Pain and Psychotherapy Research Lab / Clinical Psychology of Adulthood
resources.institution: RPTU Kaiserslautern-Landau (Landau campus)
resources.lead: Julia A. Glombiewski; Tobias Kube; Julia W. Haas
resources.description: Expectation and placebo research in chronic pain and IBS (EXPECT project on expectation updating; OLIBS open-label placebo trial), open-label placebo analgesia experiments. Kube also affiliated with Goethe University Frankfurt and Harvard PiPS.

resources.name: Placebo and Nocebo research, Clinical Psychology, Psychotherapy and Experimental Psychopathology
resources.institution: Johannes Gutenberg University Mainz
resources.description: Conditioning of nocebo hyperalgesia, open-label placebo effects, somatic symptom perception and IEI-EMF. Project page: https://klipsy.uni-mainz.de/forschung/abgeschlossen/placebo-und-noceboeffekte/

resources.name: Placebo and mindfulness research (Stefan Schmidt), Dept. of Psychosomatic Medicine
resources.institution: University Medical Center Freiburg
resources.description: Open-label placebo meta-analyses and trials, placebo mechanisms, mindfulness; board member of the Institute for Frontier Areas of Psychology and Mental Health (IGPP) Freiburg.

resources.name: Placebo research (Karin Meissner) - Integrative Medicine in Health Promotion
resources.institution: Coburg University of Applied Sciences; also LMU Munich Institute of Medical Psychology
resources.description: Placebo effects on nausea and autonomic/proteomic outcomes, nocebo effects in oncology and dysmenorrhea; SIPS member and Associate Editor of Complementary Medicine Research.

resources.name: Psychophysiology and Placebo Research Group, Dept. of Psychosomatic Medicine and Psychotherapy
resources.institution: University Hospital Tübingen
resources.description: Long-standing placebo research group (mechanisms, placebo responses in clinical trials, prediction of placebo responders, neurogastroenterology). Paul Enck's personal site with placebo resources: https://www.paul-enck.com/

resources.name: The Bingel Laboratory (Pain and cognition; Center for Translational Neuro- and Behavioral Sciences)
resources.institution: University Medicine Essen, Department of Neurology
resources.description: Interdisciplinary lab investigating how expectations and prior experience shape pain and treatment outcomes using behavioral, neuroimaging and pharmacological approaches; home of Matthias Zunhammer's placebo fMRI meta-analyses and the TRR 289 spokesperson.

resources.name: Ádám György Psychophysiology Lab (Köteles) - nocebo and interoception
resources.institution: Károli Gáspár University / ELTE, Budapest
resources.description: Nocebo effects, attribution-based symptom reporting, IEI-EMF, placebo/nocebo in performance. No official lab page could be located; Scholar URL unverified.

resources.name: Ruth Defrin Lab / TAU Pain Research Hub
resources.institution: Tel Aviv University, Dept. of Physical Therapy & Sagol School of Neuroscience
resources.description: Pain psychophysics and modulation lab; co-founder/chair of the TAU Pain Research Forum, with registered trials on experimental pain reporting and placebo response. Placebo is one strand among broader pain research.

resources.name: Weissman-Fogel Pain & Brain Lab
resources.institution: University of Haifa, Dept. of Physical Therapy
resources.description: Endogenous pain modulation, MRI/EEG/TMS studies and social-touch analgesia (with Pavel Goldstein); placebo-adjacent rather than placebo-dedicated — page does not mention placebo explicitly.

resources.name: Fabrizio Benedetti placebo laboratory, Department of Neuroscience
resources.institution: University of Turin Medical School (with Plateau Rosà hypoxia lab)
resources.lead: Fabrizio Benedetti (with Elisa Carlino, Elisa Frisaldi, Alessandro Piedimonte)
resources.description: World-leading lab on neurobiological mechanisms of placebo and nocebo effects (pain, Parkinson's disease, hypoxia, open-hidden designs). No dedicated lab website was reachable (unito.it department hosts refused connections); Wikipedia page verified as fallback.

resources.name: Placebo Responses Mapping Group / Amanzio lab, Department of Psychology
resources.institution: University of Turin
resources.description: Placebo analgesia and nocebo hyperalgesia from neuropsychological/psychophysiological perspective, adverse events in placebo arms, placebo in aging and dementia. Official unito.it pages were unreachable during verification.

resources.name: Placebo, nocebo and contextual factors in physiotherapy (Rossettini/Testa group)
resources.institution: University of Verona (School of Physiotherapy) / University of Genoa
resources.description: Research on placebo, nocebo and context effects in physiotherapy and musculoskeletal rehabilitation. No official group webpage could be fetched; profile URL unverified.

resources.name: Keith Petrie Health Psychology Group
resources.institution: University of Auckland, Faculty of Medical and Health Sciences (Psychological Medicine)
resources.description: Long-running programme on nocebo effects, symptom reporting, illness perceptions, adherence and placebo/nocebo in generic switching and media-driven side effects; trained Faasse and others.

resources.name: Magne Arve Flaten - placebo/nocebo research, Department of Psychology
resources.institution: Norwegian University of Science and Technology (NTNU), Trondheim
resources.description: Placebo analgesia, nocebo hyperalgesia, emotion/stress and pain, sex differences in placebo/nocebo, experimenter effects.

resources.name: Per Aslaksen - placebo analgesia research, Cognitive Neuroscience group
resources.institution: UiT The Arctic University of Norway, Tromsø
resources.description: Placebo analgesia mechanisms, genetic markers, nonverbal experimenter behaviour, fear and nocebo hyperalgesia, tDCS placebo interactions.

resources.name: Pain Research Group (Zespół Badania Bólu)
resources.institution: Jagiellonian University, Institute of Psychology, Kraków
resources.description: Founded 2011; learning mechanisms of placebo hypoalgesia and nocebo hyperalgesia (classical, operant and observational learning), open-label placebo, memory of pain. Hosted SIPS 2025 in Kraków. Bąbel profile: https://psychologia.uj.edu.pl/en_GB/przemyslaw-babel

resources.name: Cognitive Medical Science Lab
resources.institution: Kyung Hee University, College of Korean Medicine (Acupuncture & Meridian Science Research Center)
resources.description: Studies brain activation during expectation of sensory experience, placebo/open-label placebo acupuncture vs pills, phantom acupuncture and acupuncture expectancy scales; est. 2012.

resources.name: Charlotte Blease - placebo studies, ethics and digital health
resources.institution: Uppsala University, Dept. of Women's and Children's Health (and Harvard Medical School)
resources.description: Philosophy of medicine and placebo studies (informed consent, open-label placebo ethics, nocebo book 2024); co-founder of SIPS.

resources.name: Pain and Brain Imaging - Karin Jensen's research group
resources.institution: Karolinska Institutet, Department of Clinical Neuroscience
resources.description: fMRI-based research on placebo mechanisms (including nonconscious placebo/nocebo cues), chronic pain and patient-clinician interaction; collaborates with Harvard PiPS.

resources.name: Cosima Locher - open-label placebo research
resources.institution: University Hospital Zurich, Dept. of Consultation-Liaison Psychiatry and Psychosomatic Medicine (also Basel, Plymouth)
resources.description: Open-label placebo trials (e.g., conditioned OLP for opioid reduction in chronic pain, NCT06350786), placebo rationale/communication and qualitative studies. No official group page could be fetched; profile URL unverified.

resources.name: Research Group Jens Gaab - Clinical Psychology and Psychotherapy
resources.institution: University of Basel
resources.description: Placebo and psychotherapy research: open-label placebos (postoperative pain, PMS, test anxiety), psychological placebos, ethics; collaborations with Harvard PiPS and Italian groups. Cosima Locher trained here.

resources.name: Apkarian Lab / Center for Translational Pain Research
resources.institution: Northwestern University Feinberg School of Medicine
resources.description: Predicts placebo responses in chronic back pain and osteoarthritis from brain connectivity, psychology and language, including open-label placebo pill trials.

resources.name: Ashar Lab / Pain Science Program
resources.institution: University of Colorado Anschutz Medical Campus
resources.description: Uses fMRI, NLP and clinical trials to study how mind and brain processes influence chronic pain, including placebo-controlled trials of Pain Reprocessing Therapy and reattribution mechanisms.

resources.name: Brown Medical Expectations Lab
resources.institution: Brown University, Warren Alpert Medical School
resources.description: Examines the role of expectation in symptom relief, with a focus on open-label (honest) placebos for pain and opioid reduction.

resources.name: Coghill Lab
resources.institution: Cincinnati Children's Hospital Medical Center
resources.description: Pain neuroimaging lab studying effects of expectations, attention and cognitive modulation on pain in adults and children.

resources.name: Cognitive and Affective Neuroscience Lab (CANlab)
resources.institution: Dartmouth College, Psychological and Brain Sciences
resources.description: Neuroimaging lab investigating how thoughts, beliefs and expectations affect brain and body, including placebo analgesia mechanisms, brain signatures of pain and the Placebo Neuroimaging Consortium.

resources.name: Colloca Lab
resources.institution: University of Maryland, Baltimore
resources.description: Lab site for Colloca's group studying neurobiological and psychosocial mechanisms of placebo/nocebo effects in pain, including VR analgesia and observational learning.

resources.name: Goodin Lab (TRAPS: Translational Research to Advance Pain Science)
resources.institution: Washington University in St. Louis, Anesthesiology / Pain Center
resources.description: Clinical pain psychology lab studying psychosocial and neuroendocrine modulation of pain, with prior experimental work on placebo analgesia and expectancy.

resources.name: H.O.P.E. Lab (Headache & Orofacial Pain Effort)
resources.institution: University of Michigan School of Dentistry
resources.description: PET (mu-opioid, D2/D3) and neuromodulation research on migraine and chronic pain, including placebo components of tDCS and Zubieta-era placebo PET work (site returned HTTP 403 to automated fetch; not confirmed).

resources.name: Kathryn T. Hall - Placebo Genetics (the 'Placebome')
resources.institution: Brigham and Women's Hospital / Harvard Medical School; Director of Placebo Genetics, PiPS
resources.description: Investigates genetic and molecular predictors of placebo response (e.g., COMT), coining the 'placebome' concept for clinical-trial design.

resources.name: Kong Lab (Neuromodulation & Integrative Medicine)
resources.institution: Massachusetts General Hospital / Harvard Medical School, Psychiatry
resources.description: Studies placebo and nocebo effects, expectancy and acupuncture analgesia with neuroimaging and neuromodulation.

resources.name: Napadow Lab
resources.institution: Massachusetts General Hospital / Spaulding Rehabilitation / Harvard Medical School
resources.description: Pain neuroimaging lab studying how non-pharmacological therapies (acupuncture, sham, mindfulness) and patient-clinician interaction modulate pain; PiPS faculty.

resources.name: Pediatric Pain and Sleep Innovations Lab
resources.institution: Seattle Children's Research Institute / University of Washington
resources.description: Pediatric chronic pain lab; relevant for placebo/expectancy in pediatric pain trials and digital interventions, though placebo is not a primary stated focus.

resources.name: Randy Gollub - MGH Pain & Placebo Neuroimaging
resources.institution: Massachusetts General Hospital / Harvard Medical School, Psychiatric Neuroimaging
resources.description: Multimodal MRI studies of placebo, nocebo and acupuncture modulation of pain in healthy people and chronic pain patients (URL returned a certificate error to the automated fetch; not confirmed live).

resources.name: Raz Lab / Institute for Interdisciplinary Brain and Behavioral Sciences
resources.institution: Chapman University (Brain Institute), Orange CA
resources.description: Cognitive neuroscience of attention, suggestion, hypnosis and placebos; former magician-turned-neuroscientist featured in CBC's 'Brain Magic: The Power of Placebo'.

resources.name: Section on Affective Neuroscience and Pain (Atlas Lab)
resources.institution: NIH National Center for Complementary and Integrative Health (intramural), Bethesda
resources.description: NIH intramural lab characterizing the psychological and neural mechanisms by which expectations and other cognitive/affective factors influence pain and clinical outcomes, using fMRI, psychophysiology and computational modeling.

resources.name: Stanford Mind & Body Lab
resources.institution: Stanford University, Department of Psychology
resources.description: Studies how mindsets and expectations alter physiological and behavioral outcomes, explicitly including harnessing placebo effects in medicine, exercise, diet and stress.

resources.name: Stanford Pain Relief Innovations Lab
resources.institution: Stanford University, Anesthesiology, Perioperative and Pain Medicine
resources.description: Develops scalable behavioral pain treatments; Darnall co-authored work on optimizing placebo/minimizing nocebo and the Stanford Expectations of Treatment Scale (SETS).

resources.name: Systems Neuroscience and Pain Lab (SNAPL)
resources.institution: Stanford University, Division of Pain Medicine
resources.description: Pain neuroimaging and biomarker lab; co-developed the SETS expectancy scale and studies expectation and brain predictors of treatment response.

resources.name: Toledo Placebo Lab
resources.institution: University of Toledo, Department of Psychology
resources.description: Social/health psychology lab studying how expectations and affect shape placebo and nocebo effects, treatment side effects and health decision-making.

resources.name: Translational Neuropsychopharmacology & Neuroimaging (TNN) Lab
resources.institution: University of Pittsburgh, Department of Psychiatry
resources.description: Uses placebos as experimental probes with fMRI/PET to study how expectancies and learning shape antidepressant placebo responses and mood improvement.

resources.name: UCLA Quantitative EEG Laboratory (Leuchter)
resources.institution: UCLA Semel Institute
resources.description: Pioneered qEEG studies distinguishing placebo from medication responders in depression and brain-function changes during placebo treatment.

resources.name: Zeidan Lab (Pain, Health and Mindfulness)
resources.institution: UC San Diego, Department of Anesthesiology
resources.description: Runs mechanistically focused placebo-controlled trials dissociating mindfulness-based analgesia from placebo and sham using fMRI and opioid blockade.

resources.name: Flis (Felicity) Bishop - placebo and context effects in healthcare
resources.institution: University of Southampton, School of Psychology
resources.description: Mixed-methods research on placebo/context effects, open-label placebo acceptability, practitioner communication (Empathico), complementary medicine.

resources.name: Human Pain Research Group
resources.institution: University of Manchester
resources.description: EEG/PET research on anticipation and placebo analgesia (alpha oscillations, prefrontal mechanisms), chronic musculoskeletal pain and neurofeedback.

resources.name: Irene Tracey - P.A.I.N. group, Wellcome Centre for Integrative Neuroimaging
resources.institution: University of Oxford, Nuffield Dept. of Clinical Neurosciences
resources.description: Brain and spinal cord imaging of pain, analgesia, placebo/nocebo and reappraisal mechanisms ('Getting the pain you expect', Nat Med 2010).

resources.name: Katja Wiech - cognitive modulation of pain and placebo analgesia
resources.institution: University of Oxford, Nuffield Dept. of Clinical Neurosciences / WIN
resources.description: Neural mechanisms of beliefs and expectations on pain, including placebo analgesia, using fMRI/sMRI with behavioural and autonomic measures.

resources.name: Placebo effects in sport and exercise (Hurst/Beedie)
resources.institution: Canterbury Christ Church University (Hurst); University of Kent (Beedie)
resources.description: Placebo and nocebo effects on sports performance, supplements and doping; editors of 'Placebo Effects in Sport and Exercise' (Routledge 2023).

resources.name: Placebo Research Network (Charles Perkins Centre)
resources.institution: University of Sydney, Charles Perkins Centre
resources.description: Multidisciplinary University of Sydney network connecting researchers studying how expectations and beliefs shape health outcomes, aiming to help clinicians harness placebo effects.

resources.name: Sydney Pain Consortium (incl. Henderson/Crawford brainstem placebo imaging)
resources.institution: University of Sydney, Faculty of Medicine and Health
resources.description: University-wide pain research network whose page highlights the Henderson/Crawford 7T fMRI work on brainstem circuits of placebo analgesia and nocebo hyperalgesia and the human–rat comparison in Communications Biology.

resources.name: Treatment Expectation research network (CRC/TRR 289 partners)
resources.institution: CRC/TRR 289 Treatment Expectation
resources.description: Network of partner sites and international collaborators of the Collaborative Research Centre on treatment expectation.

resources.name: Placebo Imaging Consortium
resources.institution: International (founded 2015; led from Essen and Dartmouth)
resources.lead: Ulrike Bingel, Tor Wager, Matthias Zunhammer, Balint Kincses, Tamas Spisák
resources.description: 40+ researcher consortium pooling individual-participant placebo fMRI data for meta-analyses (JAMA Neurology 2018, Nature Communications 2021 and 2026), with shared data/code resources.

resources.name: SIPS Early Career Researcher Network
resources.institution: Society for Interdisciplinary Placebo Studies
resources.lead: Winston Tan, Helena Hartmann, Aleksandrina Skvortsova, Livia Asan
resources.description: Member-led community for placebo/nocebo researchers up to 7 years post-PhD, offering networking, mentoring and events.

resources.name: PANACEA - Erasmus+ project on placebo/nocebo education for healthcare professionals
resources.institution: University of Bologna (coordinator) with the European Pain Federation (EFIC) and European university partners
resources.description: EU-funded consortium producing training materials, clinical communication guidelines and a multi-country survey on placebo/nocebo in clinical practice (PLOS One 2026). EFIC page: https://europeanpainfederation.eu/panacea/

resources.name: Cognivia (Placebell)
resources.institution: Cognivia SA, Mont-Saint-Guibert
resources.description: Company applying psychological profiling and AI covariate adjustment to predict and reduce placebo-response variability in clinical trials; sponsor/exhibitor at SIPS conferences.

resources.name: Jay Olson - placebo and suggestion research
resources.institution: University of Toronto Mississauga, Department of Psychology
resources.description: Magician-psychologist studying elaborate placebo interventions (placebo psychedelics, sham brain-scanners, placebos for pediatric ADHD) and contextual factors.

resources.name: Bruce Barrett - Placebo, Meaning and Health
resources.institution: University of Wisconsin-Madison, Family Medicine and Community Health
resources.description: Family-medicine researcher on placebo effects and the common cold (PEP trial) and the role of meaning and expectation in healing.

resources.name: Healing Works Foundation (placebo resources)
resources.institution: Healing Works Foundation (formerly Samueli Integrative Health Programs)
resources.description: Non-profit led by former NIH OAM director offering clinician-facing guides on harnessing placebo/meaning responses in practice.

resources.name: Irving Kirsch (PiPS Associate Director)
resources.institution: Harvard Medical School / BIDMC
resources.description: Response-expectancy theorist and meta-analyst of antidepressant vs placebo effects; author of 10 books and 250+ papers on placebo, hypnosis and suggestion.

resources.name: Jon-Kar Zubieta
resources.institution: University of Utah, Department of Psychiatry
resources.description: PET pioneer of endogenous opioid and dopamine mechanisms of placebo analgesia and placebo effects as a model of resilience; now Chair of Psychiatry at Utah (university page blocked automated fetch; BBRF profile verified).

resources.name: Kari Leibowitz (mindset & placebo science)
resources.institution: Independent (Stanford Mind & Body Lab alumna)
resources.description: Health psychologist translating placebo/mindset research into clinician training (Medicine Plus Mindset) and public writing.

resources.name: Northwest Clinical Research Center
resources.institution: Northwest Clinical Research Center, Bellevue WA
resources.description: Clinical trials center whose founder has published extensively on rising placebo response and drug-placebo differences using FDA trial data across psychiatric and medical conditions.

resources.name: Samuel Nurko - Pediatric Open-Label Placebo Research
resources.institution: Boston Children's Hospital / Harvard Medical School
resources.description: Pediatric GI motility researcher who led the JAMA Pediatrics RCT of open-label placebo for children with functional abdominal pain/IBS (with Kaptchuk).

resources.name: Ted Kaptchuk (personal site)
resources.institution: Harvard Medical School / BIDMC
resources.description: Personal research site of the PiPS director, covering open-label placebo trials, the therapeutic encounter and placebo ethics.

resources.name: NCCIH (NIH National Center for Complementary and Integrative Health) – Placebo Effect resources & funding
resources.institution: US National Institutes of Health
resources.description: Primary US federal funder of placebo-mechanism research (genetics of placebo response, open-label placebo, mind–body mechanisms); page also hosts placebo lectures and research summaries.

resources.name: ECCO — Expectancy, Communication and Conditioning in placebo effects (Peerdeman)
resources.institution: Leiden University
resources.description: Kaya Peerdeman's research line on expectancy, communication and conditioning in placebo and nocebo effects, part of IPS Leiden.

resources.name: Leiden University research topic: Placebo effects
resources.institution: Leiden University
resources.lead: Henriët van Middendorp, Judy Veldhuijzen (with Kaya Peerdeman, Antoinette van Laarhoven)
resources.description: University-level research program page describing the placebo research lines (physical symptoms, mechanisms, consequences, training/pharmacological conditioning) of the IPS Leiden group; companion topic on placebo/nocebo effects of communication.

resources.name: Program in Placebo Studies & Therapeutic Encounter (PiPS)
resources.institution: Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center / Harvard Medical School
resources.lead: Ted J. Kaptchuk (Director); Irving Kirsch (Associate Director)
resources.description: Harvard-wide interdisciplinary program hosted at BIDMC that studies placebo effects, the therapeutic encounter and open-label placebos across basic, clinical and social sciences.

resources.name: IASP Special Interest Group on Pain and Placebo
resources.institution: International Association for the Study of Pain
resources.lead: Chair Luana Colloca; Treasurer Damien Finniss (Secretary Andrea Evers, deceased)
resources.description: IASP SIG promoting scientific understanding of endogenous pain modulation and placebo/nocebo effects; runs webinars (e.g., empathy in placebo biology, translating placebo science) and collaborates with U. Maryland PBO Center.

resources.name: Society for Interdisciplinary Placebo Studies (SIPS)
resources.institution: International society (founding leadership includes Kaptchuk, Colloca, Evers, Benedetti)
resources.description: International association of placebo scholars; organizes the biennial SIPS conference (6th conference: Sydney, 9-12 Feb 2027). Included here because much of its leadership is North American.
